notes.title: Update June 03 : Max Score
notes.notes:
[h1]Bugs / Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] No longer allow score to be higher than the max value of an Int32 (ie 2147483647) to comply with Valve leaderboard requirements
[*] Add dynamic font for score in menu
[*] Correct some glyphs
[*] Tone down interface sounds
[*] Other minor corrections
[/list]

notes.title: Tau Cubis is Available Now!
notes.notes:
Today's the day!
[b]Tau Cubis[/b] is finally here!

I'm happy to share Tau Cubis with you all, and for launch week, you can pick it up with a 10% launch discount!

Enjoy the game and let me know your feedback in the Steam Discussion section.
I hope you'll have a blast with Tau Cubis.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1001930/
